segments.text:
V. 19.
And he took bread—Namely, ſome Time after, when Supper was ended, wherein they had eaten the Paſchal Lamb. This is my body—As he had juſt now celebrated the Paſchal Supper, which was called the Paſſover, ſo in the like figurative Language, He calls this Bread his Body. And this Circumſtance of itſelf was ſufficient to prevent any Miſtake, as if this Bread was his real Body, any more than the Paſchal Lamb was really the Paſſover.
